title: Plasticity may be what recurrence needs to become experience

statements.text: Since feedback is found throughout the brain, recurrence alone may not suffice, and Lamme proposes that something further, perhaps neural plasticity following Hebb's rule, is needed for phenomenal experience. He has also asked whether recurrence between two connected neurons might yield some experience.

sources.quote: may be neural plasticity, since RP may satisfy Hebb’s rule
Lamme also discussed whether even RP between interconnected neuron pairs may perhaps generate some consciousness
